legacy_cells.I: 050_2023_Exploring the Untapped Potential of Synthetic Data A Comprehensive Review.pdf
legacy_cells.FR: No patient/procedural/system state-transition model or world-model results are evaluated; this is a narrative review of synthetic-data generation and healthcare applications.
legacy_cells.FX: Read the complete 7-page extracted PDF text: title and abstract (p. 1); introduction and methodology (pp. 1–2); synthetic-data generation, Bayesian networks, multiple imputation, GANs, and language models (pp. 2–4); uses and healthcare applications (pp. 5–6); conclusion and stated challenges (p. 6); references and author notes (pp. 6–7). No standalone experimental Results section or results tables are present. The metadata was read as context only; A:I remain untouched. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: Classified as a healthcare synthetic-data review, not a primary model study. It describes methods and application areas but reports no evaluated patient-state dynamics, rollouts, or world-model results. No unreadable tables or extraction issues; the full text is legible. Evidence QA: 6/6 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (100%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 6 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Model-assisted review; no independent human review or verification of cited studies.
No own model, cohort, implementation or quantitative validation results.
Forty selected articles claimed, but search dates, selection flow and excluded-study list are absent; bibliography contains 21 entries and the claimed pre-2010 set includes 2011.
Synthetic data does not automatically guarantee privacy; probabilistic DAG edges do not identify causal effects.
